notes: PROPOSAL only, not enqueued (worker does NOT create tasks via taskctl). B121 repaired the B120 guard: (1) audit_json_artifact() no longer accepts bare checks_total/checks_passed ints as sufficient acceptance evidence on their own -- a real submission must carry at least one populated named container (gates/acceptance_results/invariants_verified/tests_run); this closed the exact live gap where mcp_full_wave_dryrun_harness_b119_v1.json had drifted from an original 0-byte/echo-only dummy shape to a populated-but-fully-fabricated eval JSON (hardcoded checks_total=checks_passed=4, sha_before reused verbatim as sha_after) that the B120 guard no longer caught. (2) Added _has_unbound_positional_args_bash/_python: detects a test/harness that reads bare top-level $1/$2/.../sys.argv[N] positional CLI args this repo's zero-arg test-invocation convention can never bind, WITHOUT false-positiving on the ubiquitous, legitimate bash idiom of a helper function binding $1/$2 as its own call-time params (validated against all 42 existing tools/geoai-task-mcp/tests/*.sh scripts, 0 false positives). (3) A parallel red-team subagent then found and this task fixed three further bypasses of the EXISTING (pre-B121) echo-only/dummy-harness heuristics: padding an echo-only test with `true`/`:`/`return 0` no-op lines escaped is_echo_exit_only (fixed: _NOOP_LINE_RE recognizes these as trivial, and _ECHO_LINE_RE's character class was too narrow to even recognize `echo "Running checks..."` as an echo line -- broadened to allow common punctuation); a substance/real-io marker word (assert/open() etc.) mentioned only inside a `#` comment counted as real code (fixed: has_substance and has_real_io now scan only non-comment lines). Self-test now carries 5 isolation-safe synthetic fixtures (positive/echo-only/positional-arg-broken/noop-padded/comment-marker, mktemp-based) instead of relying solely on the live, concurrently-mutated B119 wave files, and no longer hardcodes which exact invalid_reason string a hollow submission must produce.

acknowledged_unfixed_red_team_findings: Dead-code substance leakage: a bash test can define a helper function containing real assert/comparison logic and !=/exit markers, NEVER call that function anywhere, and just echo a fixed PASS string at top level -- has_substance currently scans the whole non-comment body including unreachable function definitions, so this is not caught. Needs a lightweight call-check (does the function name appear as an invoked command elsewhere in the file, outside its own definition line?) before crediting its body's substance markers to the executed path.

Fabricated-but-well-shaped named container: an eval JSON with a real non-empty gates/acceptance_results dict where every value is a hardcoded constant (e.g. all True) still passes has_metric_container -- this is an acknowledged inherent limit of a static content-shape screen (it cannot execute or independently verify the underlying computation); the red-team subagent itself judged this not really fixable without running the actual check. Out of scope for a shape-only guard; would need either provenance/signing of eval JSONs at production time, or the neural curriculum/learned-classifier route already tracked as a next-wave item.
